applies_to: Trane packaged rooftop units with ReliaTel controls (Voyager, Precedent, Odyssey) fitted with the BCI2-R BACnet card.
summary: The BCI2-R is a BACnet MS/TP card for ReliaTel rooftop units. It talks Modbus to the unit's RTRM board and builds its BACnet object list from what the RTRM reports at first power-up, so only the objects for the installed option modules (RTEM, RTAM, RTDM, RTOM, RTVM...) appear. Objects use short instances (AI 1, AO 2, BO 1...). The BAS writes AO/BO/MO output objects and reads AI/BI/MI status and diagnostics.
notes: The tables have no read/write column. The guide states that output objects (AO/BO/MO) carry the BAS commands, setpoints and sensor values and input objects (AI/BI/MI) are status; its object-type table gives AO/BO/MO/AV a priority array, so those are marked commandable.
'When exists' conditions from the doc (RTEM, RTAM, RTDM, RTOM, RTVM, VSM option modules, gas heat, heat pump) are shown in brackets in the descriptions where they fit.
Units are given as IP/SI pairs; the BCI2-R communicates in whichever system is set under its device units (SI by default after the point list is built).
BI 151 is 'Diagnostic: Drain Pan Overflow' in the diagnostics table but 'Diagnostic: External Auto-Stop' in the doc's alphabetical index; the table name is used here.
The card can run Trane Air-Fi wireless (addresses 1-999) instead of wired BACnet MS/TP.
The 'Diagnostic:' BIs carry a BACnet notification class (001 Critical, 002 Service Required, 003 Advisory, 004 Information) and send event notifications.

source.title: Integration Guide: BACnet Communication Interface for ReliaTel Controllers (BCI2-R)

integration.summary: Set BO 1 System Control Command to Active (Trane also recommends setting its relinquish default to Active). Then put each output object the BMS will drive in service with the BCI2 Service Tool or Tracer TU. Schedule the unit with MO 7 Occupancy Request, set the mode with MO 8 and the space setpoint with AO 2. BAS sensor values must be rewritten within 900 s.

integration.enable: BO 1 System Control Command must be in service and Active (BAS Control); while Inactive the unit runs standalone and the BMS can only monitor. BI 1 System Control Status shows which is in charge. Most output objects ship with Out_of_Service = True, so the unit uses its local value; set Out_of_Service to False (BCI2 Service Tool Points screens or Tracer TU) on each output the BMS will write.
integration.heartbeat: The BAS sensor outputs with a 900 s refresh rate (AO 10, 11, 14, 15, 18, 25) must be rewritten within that time. If not, the BCI2-R puts the object in fault and the unit falls back to its own sensor. At power-up these objects start in fault until the first write. Setpoint and command outputs have no refresh limit.
integration.remote_sensors: Write BMS sensor values to the '... BAS' AOs (AO 11 Space Temperature BAS, AO 14 Outdoor Air Temperature BAS, AO 15 Outdoor Air Humidity BAS, AO 18 Space CO2 Concentration BAS, AO 25 Space Humidity BAS, AO 10 Space Static Pressure BAS) with the object in service, and keep refreshing them. The matching '... Active' AIs show the value in use.
setup: BACnet MS/TP default baud is 76,800 bps. The MS/TP address is set at the factory and printed on a label on the board; valid 001-127 (1-999 on Air-Fi).

There are no rotary dials on the current board: change the address in the embedded BCI2 Service Tool (USB cable, browser at 198.80.18.1, Installation > Identification and Communication > Protocol Configuration) or with Tracer TU 11.6 or later.
The Device ID defaults to the address; tick 'Use Software Device ID' to set a different one. Tracer SC builds its own Device IDs (e.g. 101030).
Non-Trane front ends: Max Master (Max Requestor) must be higher than the card's address or it won't be discovered.
Device units default to SI after the point list is built; to switch to IP, clear the controller with the Modbus cable unplugged (or the unit powered down) so the units selection is enabled.
The card's clock resets to Jan 1 1970 after a power loss; send TimeSynchronization from the BMS periodically.
gotchas: Writing an output object has no effect while it is Out of Service (the factory default); the unit keeps using its local value.
The point list is fixed at first power-up. After adding an option such as an economizer, clear the controller so it rebuilds the list.
BO 13 Filter Timer Reset and BO 14 Reset Diagnostic return to Inactive on their own after the reset.
The guide also names Discharge Air Temperature BAS, Duct Static Air Pressure BAS and Outdoor Airflow BAS as BAS sensor values, but no such objects are in the point tables.
BO 8 Supply Fan Configuration Command: Inactive = Auto (cycling), Active = On (continuous).
